title: Automate authorized task queues, rework, PR/CI and durable continuation
objective: Keep explicitly authorized work progressing end to end through the shared configured workflow, with durable scope, honest interruption and exact-head controlled completion.
inScope: Add the single shared operation supervisor over the existing configured driver and native gates; record #75 ownership of reusable operation semantics and defer planning and HTTP.
Select only complete schema-valid committed definitions within a trusted host grant; preserve native dependencies, exact inputs and deterministic selection.

Drive isolated provider sessions, validation, independent reviews, bounded legal rework, non-force publication, canonical PR readiness and policy-controlled merge; continue to the next eligible authorized task.
Persist operation, grant, source, assignment, attempt and effect bindings before dispatch. Preserve budgets across retries and restarts; reconcile uncertain effects and retain one project writer.
Expose shared service and CLI inspect, pause/drain, cancel and resume semantics, durable clarification and actionable exceptions; preserve manual compatibility and stopped rollback.
outOfScope: Distributed scheduling, parallel project writers, arbitrary issue admission, conversational planning or HTTP implementation, unbounded repair, package release, weakening existing protection or broadening worker credential privileges.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-01: A grant covering at least two dependent tasks executes them in order through completion without routine human handoffs or per-task selection.
AC-02: Real isolated role sessions, validators, reviews, legal rework, PR/CI and controlled merge are driven by the same existing authority owners.
AC-03: Semantic failure creates an auditable successor attempt when allowed; infrastructure retry preserves identity; budgets survive restart.
AC-04: Duplicate starts/events and uncertain side effects cannot duplicate assignment, evidence, active provider work, PRs or merge.
AC-05: Out-of-scope work, exhausted budgets, unsafe recovery and unresolved clarification become durable actionable exceptions.
AC-06: Cancellation, revocation and pause/drain reflect real external writers and retain a supported resume path.
AC-07: Service/CLI operation semantics align with #75 and use the installed package; no competing supervisor is introduced.
validationPlan: Run every README fresh-checkout check, installed package conformance and exact-head GitHub CI; obtain separate QA, Architecture and UAT/Product reviews.
Exercise authorized queue order, out-of-scope and incomplete inputs, legal validation/review rework, stale/dirty heads, durable budgets, bounded exponential backoff and CI waits/failures.
Exercise competing starts, duplicate events, restart at effect boundaries and lost push/PR/merge acknowledgements without duplicate assignments, providers, evidence, PRs or merges.

Demonstrate two dependent tasks through the installed package with real fresh isolated provider role sessions, actual validators and owning native gates through DONE; label remote integration ports as deterministic test doubles. Separately establish actual AUT-003 delivery with independent final reviews, canonical GitHub PR, exact-head CI and native controlled completion. This is feature work, not a new canary requirement.
Exercise cancellation, revocation, pause/drain, uncertain external writers, supported resume and stopped manual rollback while preserving original operation and native history.
